scope_note: Main set follows the six initial GonitSathi topic groups: percentages/profit-loss; ratios/proportions; work/time; speed/distance; averages/mixtures; elementary algebra/number relations. Geometry, set theory, probability, combinatorics, and mental-ability-only items are logged as excluded for this initial benchmark.
gold_label_warning: Model-authored solutions, histories, probes, and diagnostic labels are drafts. The guideline requires independent mathematically competent Bengali-speaking human review/adjudication before gold test use.
